Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,146.13 down -91.93 points April 20, 2018, 04:45:06 PM EDT By NASDAQ.com News Shutterstock photo 
Friday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,146.13. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2 billion. Declining stocks led advancers by 1.7 to 1 ratio. There were 1110 advancers and 1885 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 32 stocks reached a 52 week high and 43 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page. 
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -1.58% for the day; a total of -107.14 points. The current value is 6,667.75. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change down (-4.1%) while Shire plc ( SHPG ) had the largest percent change gain rising 2.26%. The Dow Jones index closed down -.82% for the day; a total of -201.95 points. The current value is 24,462.94. Apple Inc.
